newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ to release monetary policy statement June 27.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ to release monetary policy statement June 27.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Wednesday it would release its June Monetary Policy Statement at 9.00 a.m. (2000 GMT) on June 27.
The statement, one of two every year, is considered to be one of the most significant announcements the bank makes and should help clafiry its view on current market-led monetary conditions.
